common.style_usage: Stardew Valley artisan machine pixel art: palette, outline, wood and metal shading, size (one tile wide, two tall) and the front-on view with the top seen from above, like the keg, preserves jar and oil maker
common.reference_usage: outline and size: a machine one tile wide and two tall, standing on the floor

pigment_mill.description: one Stardew Valley artisan machine, a Pigment Mill for grinding colors: a wooden stand with a round stone grinding wheel on top turned by a little iron crank handle, a small chute at the front with colorful pigment powder and a paint tube coming out, a few dabs of bright paint on the wood. Same size and style as the keg and preserves jar. Machine only, transparent background.
